# Schumann Op.68 validation sources

These eighteen Mutopia source files retain their original headers, editor attribution, publication metadata and license notices. Each file and its derived event/label records remain under its recorded Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 2.5 or 3.0 license. See the source header and the pinned source links in reservation.json. Robert Schumann is the composer; source editors are credited in each file. Whitespace was normalized as recorded in the reservation. Subsequent corpus conversion, where supported, resolves the written pitch and rhythm through LilyPond and separates printed digit labels from planner inputs. It does not change the source musical content.

License texts: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/2.5/ and https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/ . These evaluation-only files are not application assets. Unsupported notation and ambiguous annotations must remain visible in the evaluation inventory.
